description.value: Cream Pony is a North Vancouver favourite specialising in fried chicken and handmade donuts, tucked into the Shipyards District off Lolo Lane behind East 1st Street. The shop has earned a devoted local following for its glazed donuts and juicy chicken sandwiches, and also offers catering. It is a second location alongside a Vancouver outpost in Mount Pleasant.
